definitions.explanation: A red cosmetic applied to the lips or cheeks. Traditionally made from safflower petals. In modern use, often refers to lipstick.
A vivid, deep red color. Used as a color term, especially in traditional or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞妓|まいこ}→舞妓：15099_maiko⟧さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧な{紅|べに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唇|くちびる}→唇：03903_kuchibiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}っている→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: The maiko is applying bright red rouge to her lips.

examples.japanese: {紅花|べにばな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{紅|べに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{伝|つた}わっている→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: The technique of making rouge from safflower has been passed down since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {紅|べに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The autumn leaves dyed crimson are beautiful.

notes:
USAGE:
The phrase {紅|べに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さす (apply rouge) is the classic collocation. As a color, {紅|べに} has a more traditional, literary feel than ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ (red). It appears in many compounds such as {紅花|べにばな} (safflower), {紅|べに}{鮭|ざけ} (sockeye salmon), and ⟦{口紅|くちべに}→口紅：00249_kuchibeni⟧ (lipstick).

FORMS:
The kanji {紅|べに} can also be read as ⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧, which is a more poetic reading for the crimson color.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紅|べに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さす: apply rouge/lipstick
- ⟦{口紅|くちべに}→口紅：00249_kuchibeni⟧: lipstick
- {紅花|べにばな}: safflower
- {紅|べに}{鮭|ざけ}: sockeye salmon
- {紅|べに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: be dyed crimson
